correctness.rationale: Characteristic-two identification with exterior algebra is exact for the group algebra. Linear leading terms are automorphic to a generator (rank16). Nondegenerate quadratic terms reduce via homogeneous variable substitutions to rank-four bivectors (rank12). Decomposable quadratics reduce to z1z2 + gamma z3z4z5; tensor-complex homology yields ranks 8/10. Vanishing quadratics leave cubic alternating ranks 2/4 and operator ranks 4/6; higher-only elements give ranks 2/1. Counts by radical of alternating forms and nonzero wedge functional give all nine coefficients, totaling q^31. Actual GF2 and GF4 independent operator-matrix computation passes; finite checks are supporting only.

value.rationale: The augmentation ideal and left regular representation of a finite modular group algebra are canonical natural algebraic objects. A complete rank/Jordan-type census across all elements captures distinctions invisible to cyclic shifted-subgroup freeness. Five generators is the first dimension allowing a decomposable quadratic and disjoint cubic with nonzero top wedge; the rank-10 phenomenon and its exact finite-field population are mathematically motivated and not a routine parameter substitution. The formula connects finite-field alternating-form orbit counts, inhomogeneous normal forms, and differential-complex homology; it is a usable exact arithmetic invariant.
